dct_description_sm: "This plan is a true representation of a survey made on the waters of the River Tickfaw and on the west side thereof and contains 20,000 a. from the line of Thomas Power to the dotted line bearing N 70°E 438p, and surveyed the 8th January 1804 by order of Captn. Vincent Pintado."
Annotations on verso are obscured by cloth backing.
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Black pen-and-ink, pencil, and watercolor on cloth, mounted cloth-backed paper.
